title: Patriots Stock Watch 1.0: Who is rising, falling on depth chart after 11 days of practice?
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: A.J. Brown and Christian Gonzalez impress in Patriots camp, showing potential as dynamic plays unfold.
Dre'Mont Jones' physicality shines, enhancing Patriots' pass-rush while players like Kyle Williams struggle.
Terrell Jennings, a standout among running backs, gains advantage over competitors for roster spots.

title: Could Franklin Arias join Red Sox before end of 2026 season?
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Franklin Arias batting .326 with 12 RBIs in 10 games for Triple-A Worcester.
Red Sox considering call-up for Arias amid shortstop injuries and roster changes.
Craig Breslow emphasizes continued development for 20-year-old prospect Arias.

title: Police search for person they say broke into Jamaica Plain apartment, tried to pull blanket off sleeping victim
author: Audrey Cooney
bullets: Boston police seek public help to identify suspect in Jamaica Plain apartment break-in on August 5.
Suspect entered the victim's bedroom through a window and tried to pull a blanket off the sleeping individual.
The suspect is a Black male in late teens or early 20s, wearing a white t-shirt and black and white cap.

title: Why did this part break so quickly on my 2023 pickup?
author: John Paul
bullets: A 2023 Ford Maverick owner experiences broken front sway bar links at 22,000 miles; advised to check warranty for repair.
Torx-Plus fasteners are used over Torx for better precision and durability in automated assembly processes.
CTEK and Deltran are recommended brands for quality battery maintainers for vehicles like a Porsche Macan.

title: 5 takeaways from Jaylen Brown’s introductory press conference with 76ers
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Jaylen Brown expressed mixed emotions about his trade from the Celtics to the 76ers, highlighting his 10-year tenure in Boston.
Brown acknowledged a 'nonexistent' off-court relationship with former Celtics teammate Jayson Tatum after the trade to Philadelphia.
Despite his departure, Brown expressed gratitude for his development in Boston and plans to continue philanthropic work there.

title: 4 injured in Boston school bus rollover, police say
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: Four adults injured in a school bus rollover in Mattapan on Thursday, taken to a local hospital.
The rollover occurred near 1000 Harvard St. around 1:10 p.m.; no children were on board the bus.
The cause of the school bus accident remains unclear, and police have not released further details.

title: Drake Maye struggled during two-minute drill, and other takeaways from Day 11 of Patriots training camp
author: Khari A. Thompson
bullets: Drake Maye threw two interceptions during Patriots' two-minute drill, with Marcus Jones and Kevin Byard making key defensive plays.
Marcus Bryant took first-team reps at left tackle as Will Campbell was limited due to injury, bypassing first-round pick Caleb Lomu.
Christian Gonzalez and A.J. Brown showcased competitiveness in their matchups, emphasizing skill development and spirited exchanges.

title: A beloved Cape Cod restaurant is closing after 21 years
author: Kristi Palma
bullets: Chach Restaurant in Provincetown will close on November 2 after 21 years of operation.
Owners Viola Briseño and Sharon Bowes cited the demanding nature of the business as their reason for closing.
Chach is renowned for its scratch-made dishes, popular breakfast items, and seasonal specials in Provincetown.

title: The best movies on Netflix right now (August 2026)
author: Kevin Slane
bullets: Popular movies newly added to Netflix in August 2026 include 'Clueless' and 'Eighth Grade.'
The list features a variety of genres, from romantic comedies to crime dramas, to help viewers select films based on taste.
'His Three Daughters' and 'Maestro' are highlighted for their engaging storytelling and noteworthy performances.

title: Navy says it can’t help recover wreckage of Gloucester fishing boat Lily Jean
author: Beth Treffeisen
bullets: The US Navy declined Gov. Maura Healey's request to help recover the Lily Jean fishing boat wreckage.
The vessel sank off Cape Ann in January 2026 with seven aboard; the USCG and NTSB lead the investigation.
Gov. Healey and state officials continue efforts to retrieve crucial data to determine the cause of the sinking.
